description: Adds rows to the end of one of your firing logs (an id from list_firings), in the log's own columns (get_firing gives them): the readings dictated during a firing. The rows already there stay as they are, and the log as it was is kept as an earlier version. At most 500 rows a log. Save only what the person said and agreed to; never fill in an amount, temperature or analysis they did not give. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

rows.description: The new readings, in the log’s own columns (get_firing gives them), each row a cell for each column.

name: add_firing_rows
title: Add readings to one of my firing logs
